verdict.rationale: The pricing page says the open-source library is free ('at no cost'), so self-hosted license cost is predictable. However, the same page describes an assessment-led engagement (decision inventory, CIC score, plan for measuring returns) rather than published per-search, per-record, or per-node rates for the managed Cloud offering. missing for 10: published per-unit pricing (searches/records/nodes) for Orama Cloud, a usage-based price calculator or tier limits, independent confirmation of pricing transparency.
